intro: The Twin Colossals are a pair of towering, sheer-faced mesas that dominate the northwestern skyline of Feralas. Rising high above the canopy, the narrow passage between their sheer cliffs forms the primary overland route connecting Feralas with the arid wastes of Desolace to the north.

p: Towering over the western reaches of Feralas, the Twin Colossals stand as the highest landforms in the region. Their vertical rock faces cut a striking silhouette against the sky, serving as unmistakable landmarks for travelers venturing south out of Desolace. While the lower slopes merge into the dense jungle and the lands stretching toward the Forgotten Coast, the summits are isolated plateaus far above the forest floor.

Scaling the vertical cliffs on foot is impossible, yet the summits are not entirely deserted. An intrepid night elf named Marli Wishrunner assists travelers seeking passage to the eastern peak. Those who ascend find a tranquil pond perched atop the stone mesa—though it is inhabited by an unusually large makrura named Diamond Head. To aid adventurers in returning to earth, Kalin Windflight offers sturdy parachutes to descend back into the jungle canopy below.
